title: Splendours of Sri Lanka with Sigiriya and Mirissa in Seven Days
alt: A blue whale surfacing off Mirissa
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Hilltop hotel with a pool looking down on Kandy

activities.name: Pinnawala and the Kandyan dance
activities.description: The elephant sanctuary on the way up, then the upper lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance.

activities.name: Tooth Relic temple and excursion to Sigiriya
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic in the morning, then the climb to the summit of the rock fortress.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights above Kandy with the elephants and the dance show on the first day, then the Tooth Relic temple and a day at Sigiriya.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Hill country hotel among the tea bushes above Nuwara Eliya

activities.name: Nuwara Eliya sightseeing and tea plantation
activities.description: Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, the colonial town and a tea plantation and factory.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Up into the tea country for a night among the bushes with a tour of the town and a plantation.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Beachfront hotel at Wadduwa on the way to Bentota

activities.name: Bentota sightseeing and the turtle hatchery
activities.description: The Madu River boat, the Kosgoda turtle hatchery and the beach.

activities.name: Excursion to Mirissa
activities.description: Along the southern coast to Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill; from November to April an optional whale watching boat leaves at dawn.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights by the sea with the Madu River and the turtles on arrival and a day at Mirissa, in season the whale watching capital of the island.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · City hotel a short walk from Galle Face Green

activities.name: Colombo sightseeing tour
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the capital with a tour of its temples, colonial quarter and markets.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in above Kandy and the upper lake drive
The Kandyan dance performance in the evening
2: Breakfast, then the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
A transfer north to the rock fortress
The water gardens, the mirror wall and the summit ruins
Back to Kandy for the night
3: Breakfast and a transfer up to Nuwara Eliya
A tea plantation and factory visit on the climb
Gregory Lake, Victoria Park and the colonial town
Check in among the tea bushes
4: Breakfast and a long transfer down from the hills
A boat on the Madu River and the Kosgoda turtle hatchery
5: Optional: a dawn whale watching boat from Mirissa harbour (November to April)
Breakfast and an excursion along the southern coast
Mirissa beach and the palms of Coconut Tree Hill
Back to Bentota for the night

Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Seven days on a budget with Sigiriya and Mirissa both in: two nights in Kandy with the elephants, the dance show and the rock, a night in the tea country, two nights by the sea with the Madu River, the turtles and Mirissa, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 6 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; the upper lake drive and Kandyan dance performance; the Tooth Relic temple and an excursion to Sigiriya; Nuwara Eliya sightseeing and a tea plantation; Bentota sightseeing with the turtle hatchery; an excursion to Mirissa; the Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; the whale watching boat; lunches and dinners; entrance tickets; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
